title: Gary Cardone: Wall Street Is Taking Over Bitcoin — For Good
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Gary Cardone: Wall Street Is Taking Over Bitcoin — For Good Gary Cardone explains why Bitcoin shrugs off regulatory setbacks, why $75K is holding firm, and why he’d welcome a brief dip into the low $70s to buy more.
